d: Platinum white hair is styled into two voluminous, curly twin-tails with blunt-cut bangs framing the face. The eyes are a deep navy blue with a gentle, smiling expression on a face with the apparent maturity of a late teenager. The build is slender with a prominent chest. The outfit consists of a white double-breasted military jacket with gold epaulettes, a red bow tie, a grey pleated mini-skirt, and a navy blue kepi topped with a red and white striped bow. A silver anchor ornament is attached to the waist.
